source.prompt: swappable switch mechanical keyboard with usb c under 4000
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
If you mean **₹4,000 in India**, there are some very good hot-swappable options with **USB-C** right now.

### My picks

- **Kreo Hive 75 / Hive 75 V2 — ~₹3,100–₹3,200**

75% / 87-key layout
**5-pin hot-swap**
USB-C wired
Gasket + sound-dampening
Volume knob
Great choice if you want a **75% keyboard**.
- **Cosmic Byte CB-GK-42 Phantom TKL — ~₹3,000**

TKL / 82 keys
**Hot-swappable Outemu Reds**
USB-C detachable cable
Silicone gasket
Per-key RGB
**Best value if you want F-row + arrow keys.**
- **Redragon K668 — ~₹3,800–₹4,000**

Full-size 108 keys
**3/5-pin hot-swap**
USB-C
Sound-absorbing foam
1000 Hz polling
Pick this if you **need a numpad**.
- **Redragon K617 Fizz — ~₹2,200**

60% / 61 keys
**3/5-pin hot-swap**
USB-C
RGB
Excellent cheap option, but no dedicated arrow/F-row keys.

### 🏆 What I'd buy

**Kreo Hive 75 V2** if you want the best overall experience under ₹4k. It gives you the modern 75% layout, hot-swap, USB-C, sound dampening and a knob without using the whole budget.

If you tell me **60% / 65% / 75% / TKL / full-size** and whether you want **red, brown, or blue switches**, I can narrow it down to the **best 2–3 options under ₹4,000**.
